content: यज्वन् {%a.%} (यज्वरी|{%f.%}) [यज्-क्वनिप्] Sacrificing, worshipping, adoring <ab>&c.</ab> --{%m.%} .²1 One who performs sacrifices in accordance with Vedic precepts, a performer of sacrifices; नीपान्वयः पार्थिव एष यज्वा <ls>R. 6. 46</ls>, <ls n="R.">1. 4</ls>, <ls n="R.">3. 39</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 12</ls>; <ls>Ku. 2. 46</ls>; hence यज्वनां पतिः = The moon. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu.
